Application Data.NAME: Creative Crafts Co.
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Creative Crafts Co. is a retail store specializing in craft and hobby supplies, including a wide range of products such as model-building kits, paints, adhesives, tools, and accessories. Our inventory is meticulously managed with regular stock audits and secure storage to ensure quality and safety. The premises are well-maintained, featuring clear aisles and proper lighting, with adherence to all local fire and safety codes. We also offer instructional classes in various crafting techniques, enhancing customer engagement while maintaining a focus on safety and compliance.

3.77
Hobby & Model Shops
Underwriting Appetite
• Preferred:
– Retail stores primarily selling hobby and model-building supplies such as plastic kits,
paints, adhesives, tools, and related accessories, with no sales or rentals of hazardous
materials (e.g., flammable solvents, compressed gases) exceeding minimal quantities.
– Businesses demonstrating strong inventory control systems (e.g., regular stock audits,
secure storage) and a clean safety record with no recent history of claims related to
customer or employee injuries.
– Shops with well-maintained premises featuring clear aisles, proper lighting, and adher-
ence to local fire and safety codes.
• Acceptable:
– Hobby shops offering instructional classes or workshops (e.g., model-building, painting
techniques) provided they carry appropriate professional liability coverage to address
potential errors or omissions.
